notes.title: The wait is over! Join the Playtest now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620296/c6c250e9c57573e15267efe0b9bcf5fa96215534.png

After nearly a year of solo development, I’m excited to finally share the open Steam Playtest build of A Kingdom Together,  a persistent multiplayer strategy game where every building, unit, and economy is shaped by real players.

This is a huge milestone for the project, and I’d love to have strategy and indie game fans give it a spin and let me know what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620296/abd43cb37f59e43d8db9779283cf7b0d6546e448.png

What Is A Kingdom Together?

A Kingdom Together is an MMORTS where players are grouped into four kingdoms, collaborating (and competing) to build sprawling cities, craft units, manage logistics and economy, build siege engines and conquer regions of a dynamic map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620296/7a815a03abfd07464830b5ebd6038ced009d9f17.png

At its core, the game blends:


 RTS-style building placement
 Custom unit design
 Resource production and crafting
 Player-owned economy and trading
 Quests, skills, and persistent world progression


Every building you see is placed by a player. Every unit you encounter belongs to a real person. The world grows because of you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620296/4cafdce529756ff47fcd07e3ca59a2530d89362e.png

What's in the First Test Build?
This first build is early, but it includes the key systems for testing:


 Building & Unit Production
 Infantry, archers, cavalry & siege units
 Basic quest system (7 quests to introduce the mechanics)
 Live in-game chat system
 Territory control and map structure
 PVP from across 2 buildings.


Please join the Discord to actively participate in the game's development!

Also check out the latest devlog here!
